security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, local LibreOffice examples, and documentation links. Two findings remain confirmed: unpinned pip install guidance and a troubleshooting block that can terminate LibreOffice processes. No prompt injection, credential access, or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin package versions or move package installation to prerequisites that require explicit user confirmation before running pip.
Replace killall guidance with a safer process check and tell users to save work before stopping LibreOffice processes.

remediation.issue: Local UNO listener lacks safety notes
remediation.suggestion: State that the UNO listener must bind only to localhost and should be shut down after automation finishes.

content.value_statement: Teams need repeatable diagrams and exports without manual LibreOffice steps. This skill guides LibreOffice Draw creation, conversion, and automation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Create ODG drawings and diagrams with LibreOffice Draw workflows.
Convert drawings between ODG, SVG, PDF, PNG, JPG, and related formats.
Use Python UNO examples to create and store Draw documents.
Plan flowcharts, org charts, technical drawings, and reusable templates.
Batch convert local ODG files through LibreOffice headless commands.
limitations: Requires LibreOffice and the soffice command on the local machine.
Python UNO automation requires a running local LibreOffice listener.
Example paths and filenames must be adapted before use.
Conversion quality still needs visual review for complex drawings.

use_cases.title: Prepare Documentation Diagrams
use_cases.description: Create editable ODG diagrams and export SVG or PDF assets for manuals, specs, and knowledge bases.

use_cases.title: Automate Drawing Exports
use_cases.description: Convert many local Draw files into delivery formats through repeatable headless LibreOffice workflows.

use_cases.title: Build Diagram Templates
use_cases.description: Design reusable Draw templates for flowcharts, org charts, and technical schematics.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Diagram
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new editable drawing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a LibreOffice Draw plan for a simple process diagram with five steps, labels, and export options.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Existing Drawings
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for local format conversion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me convert a folder of ODG files to PDF and SVG. Include prerequisites, safe checks, and expected outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Reusable Template
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for standard diagram production.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reusable LibreOffice Draw template for technical architecture diagrams with layers, object naming, and export rules.

prompt_templates.title: Automate with UNO
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for scripted Draw document generation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Python UNO workflow that creates a Draw document, adds labeled shapes, saves ODG output, and exports a PDF copy.

output_examples.input: I need an editable flowchart and a PDF export for a support escalation process.
output_examples.output: A Draw workflow with named layers, shape layout guidance, ODG source output, and a PDF export checklist.

output_examples.input: Convert these ODG drawings to web-ready SVG files.
output_examples.output: A local conversion plan that checks LibreOffice availability, processes each drawing, and asks for visual review after export.

output_examples.input: Create a standard template for network architecture diagrams.
output_examples.output: A template plan with layers, reusable symbols, labeling rules, and export settings for SVG and PDF delivery.

best_practices: Keep editable ODG source files in version control with exported assets.
Use layers, object names, and templates for repeatable diagram updates.
Review every exported image or PDF before publishing it.
anti_patterns: Running package installation commands without user confirmation.
Using blanket process termination while unsaved LibreOffice documents may be open.
Treating converted output as final without visual quality checks.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create LibreOffice Draw diagrams, templates, and exports in formats such as ODG, SVG, PDF, and PNG.

faq.question: Does it require LibreOffice?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows rely on LibreOffice Draw and the soffice command being available locally.

faq.question: Can it batch convert drawings?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes local batch conversion guidance for ODG files and common export formats.

faq.question: Can it automate Draw with Python?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides UNO-based automation guidance for creating and saving Draw documents.

faq.question: Is it safe to run every command automatically?
faq.answer: No. Package installation and process termination commands should require explicit confirmation first.

faq.question: Can it guarantee perfect export quality?
faq.answer: No. Complex drawings can render differently across formats, so exported files need visual review.
